text: 商务部外贸司副司长贺少军在28日举行的国新办发布会上表示，根据海关统计，今年上半年，我国工业机器人、3D打印机等人工智能相关产品出口表现亮眼，同比分别增长18.6%、109.3%，成为中国外贸“新名片”。（新华社）
text_en: Vice Director of the Ministry of Commerce's Foreign Trade Department He Shaojun stated at a State Council Information Office press conference on the 28th that, according to customs statistics, in the first half of this year, China's exports of AI-related products such as industrial robots and 3D printers performed strongly, with year-on-year growth of 18.6% and 109.3% respectively, becoming a new "calling card" for China's foreign trade. (Xinhua News Agency)
